name: search_products
description: Search the Umbra Electric catalog by keyword, category slug and/or maximum price. Returns matching products with slug, name, price, currency, category and URL.

query.description: Free-text search across product name, brand and description

category.description: Category slug to filter by, e.g. adult-electric-dirt-bikes

name: get_product
description: Get full details for one product by slug: description, price, brand, category, warranty, images and FAQs.

name: list_categories
description: List all product categories with slug, title, description and model count.

name: get_policies
description: Get Umbra Electric's shipping, returns, payment and minimum-order policies.

name: get_wholesale_info
description: Get information on Umbra Electric's wholesale/dealer application process.

name: create_order_draft
description: Prepare a draft order summary and a WhatsApp link pre-filled with the order details for a human to review and complete. Never captures payment or personal data.

items.description: Products to include in the draft order

notes.description: Optional note to include in the order message
